profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at Lennox International
profile.summary:
Principal-level full-stack software engineer with 20+ years designing, modernizing, and delivering enterprise-scale platforms across cloud, eCommerce, and distributed systems. Recently authored and led team-wide adoption of an AI context engineering framework for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, establishing structured context, prompt design, and governance practices that improved AI-assisted development across a multi-system enterprise platform. Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, SQL, cloud architecture, and CI/CD automation. Proven ability to lead engineering teams, mentor developers, and collaborate with product and architecture groups to build scalable, resilient systems aligned with long-term business strategy.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend & Cloud: Java 21/25 (LTS), Spring Boot, C#/.NET, JPA, REST APIs, Microservices
AI-Assisted Engineering: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Context Engineering, Prompt Design, Agent-Based Development Workflows
Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, jQuery, JSP
Messaging & Integration: MuleSoft, WCF, SOAP/REST, MQTT (Red Hat AMQ Broker, EMQX), WebSocket/STOMP, OPC UA (Eclipse Milo)
Databases: SQL, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Stored Procedures
Identity & Security: Keycloak/OIDC
DevOps & CI/CD: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, Maven, Docker, Dynatrace, Splunk
Platforms: SAP Hybris, Salesforce, .NET, WPF
Certifications: Certified Scrum Master, Certified Product Owner

positions.title: Applications Delivery Principal
positions.description:
- Own quality releases for eCommerce, Salesforce, and MuleSoft initiatives across onshore/offshore teams, ensuring reliable and timely delivery.
- Lead developer for a multi-phase modernization of a legacy Windows-based Engineering Drawing application into a cloud-based, API-driven solution. Phase 1: migrated the legacy VB6 application to C#/.NET using GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate code translation and validation. Phase 2 (in progress): migrating local AutoCAD integration to AutoCAD's cloud API and porting the codebase to Java/Spring Boot, improving scalability, accessibility, and long-term maintainability
- AI Context Engineering Framework (GitHub Copilot & Claude Code)
Authored and led team-wide adoption of an AI context engineering framework (Gartner's Agent Development Lifecycle model) standardizing GitHub Copilot and Claude Code usage across a 9-system enterprise platform. Built a 50+ file context repository and governance processes for consistent AI-assisted development across a distributed team.
- Increase customer engagement through proactive monitoring and platform enhancements that improve user experience and system performance.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product stakeholders to define short- and long-term roadmaps aligned with business strategy.
- Drive the migration of Customer Service operations to Salesforce Service Cloud, integrating with eCommerce systems to improve SLA and issue resolution speed.
- Manage relationships with external cloud service providers including MuleSoft and Esker (cloud-based OCR), ensuring seamless integration and operational stability.
Mentor engineers and guide best practices in cloud architecture, CI/CD, and modern development frameworks.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led engineering for Lennox's eCommerce modernization, migrating legacy Windows applications to SAP Hybris and building microservice-style capabilities that significantly increased customer self-service adoption.
Modernized legacy Windows applications by migrating to SAP Hybris, enabling scalable, cloud-ready eCommerce capabilities.
- Designed and delivered online quoting, CPQ configuration, real-time pricing, order tracking, and parts lookup.
- Built a high-impact Warranty Processing Application that automated workflows and reduced fraud, generating 30% cost savings.
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments using Jenkins and Azure DevOps, improving release velocity and reliability.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led full‑stack development of fitting software using WPF/XAML, SQL Server, and automated UI testing frameworks.
- Coordinated deployment and support for 300+ retail locations, ensuring high availability and smooth rollout.
- Transitioned engineering from Waterfall to Agile; implemented JIRA workflows and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to accelerate delivery.
- Maintained and enhanced ASP.NET‑based training platform with video/PDF content and quiz features; implemented Selenium UI automation.
- Built distributed data synchronization solutions across 400+ retail outlets using WCF services and SQL Server.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led a team of six engineers building a high‑performance live streaming engine using C#, ASP.NET, DirectShow, and FFmpeg.
- Integrated streaming solutions with major CDNs (Akamai, Limelight), achieving certification and expanding product compatibility.
- Designed and implemented features supporting MPEG2, H.264/AAC, and multicast/unicast streaming, including UI configuration tools.
- Collaborated with third‑party vendors on requirements, integration, and production rollout.
- Provided pre‑ and post‑sales engineering support to customers and sales teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Product Owner
positions.description:
- Sr. Software Engineer for multimedia middleware package, with oversight of entire package that provides features for internal as well as 3rd part developers for Audio/Video Playback, Metadata, FM Radio, Telephone/VoIP and other multimedia related features managed with help of 3 scrum teams.
- Lead and part of team that implemented OpenMax AL and Qt mobility Multimedia backend for Symbian phones.
- Lead a team that developed Telephone Multimedia API/Engine for Symbian Phones.
- Lead a team that was doing development/maintenance of multimedia middleware components for  audio playback and recording.
- Smooth Transition of multimedia middleware package from Nokia Internal (Private) to Symbian foundation (Public) Licensing model.
- Provided roadmap for transition of multimedia middleware package from Avkon to Qt based UI Framework as part of Next Generation multimedia project.
- Ramped up two new scrum teams in Irving, TX, with its own product backlog for multimedia middleware, backlog included introduction of several new features in multimedia middleware package, with emphasis on flexible/Open APIs to better support internal as well as 3rd party application developers. Introduced new APIs like OpenMax AL, Telephone Multimedia Service APIs.
- Smooth transition of legacy multimedia components from Sasken, Mexico to a separate scrum team located in Nokia, Bangalore, with its own product backlog. During the transition there was no delay in releasing new features for legacy multimedia architecture with very low error count for successful launch of Symbian^3 based Nokia devices like N8 & C7
- Co-ordinate and lead a team between various locations in US/Finland/India during final integration/certification process for introduction of Dolby Digital Audio in Symbian ^ 3, resulting in successful certification of N8 device by Dolby labs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead / Scrum Master
positions.description:
- Lead a team that ported GStreamer Framework to S60/Symbian, worked also with Legal team in resolving any licensing issue with using opensource framework.
- Lead a team that Successfully prototyped GST-OMX IL port to work on Symbian platform for AAC Recording usecase
- Ramp up/Train/Managed Sub contractors (Sasken, Mexico) working on Project maintenance for legacy features while keeping error count low and help timely launch of Nokia products and keeping maintenance cost low
- Successfully handover of all Audio Codec’s from Nokia, Irving to new team in Nokia, Bangalore. Without causing any delay or disruption to product programs.
- Managed project from Nokia side, solving fragmented audio device drivers being implemented by all symbian licenses, by successful creating and defining a well documented audio device driver interface that works for all Symbian Licensee
- Provided support when Nokia merged with Symbian, in defining common developer tools and process and help successfully integration of Symbian with Nokia.
- Provided On site technical Support to Samsung and LG for creating S60 based products, with emphasis in audio device driver and interfaces for S60.
- Provided Support to 3rd party clients by working with Forum Nokia, in supporting clients like Fring/Skype/KodiaPTT for issue found during porting of apps to different nokia products

positions.title: Software Enginner
positions.description:
- Test Engineer for Symbain Group, Developed Test plans, Design, write and execute test code for VoCoS (Voice Recognition System), Converter, Composer Apps for Symbian OS 6.1
Maintenance of Converter App for Symbian OS 6.1 (Series 60 1.X)
Maintenance of Audio Adaptation Layer for Calypso Project for Symbian OS 6.1 (Series 60 1.X)
- Design, Develop, Maintenance of Audio Adaptation Software (Size Architecture) for Symbian OS 7.0S (Series 60 2.X).
Develop, Maintenance of Audio Adaptation Software for (Convergence Architecture) for Symbain OS 7.0S for OMAP 1510 Chipset (Series 60 2.X)
- Technical Lead for Audio Adaptation Software for OMAP 1510 Chipset.
- Provide support to 3rd Party developers via Forum Nokia and Support to S60 Licenses for Audio related issues.
- Provide support to Next Generation of Audio Architecture (S60 3.0) for Audio Adaptation and System Integration Support for Audio to work with Series 60 3.0
- Design, Develop eAAC+ Codec wrapper for Series 60 3.0
- Integrated S60 to use DirectX as device drivers for Audio Processing and Audio Effects emulation for S60 SDK

positions.title: Software Enginner
positions.description:
- Developed Prototype for Routing messages (SMSC) across different air interfaces (GSM/CDMA) in JAVA
- Maintenance and Customer Support for Nokia's WAP Gateway

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
- Team Lead on F16/F22 Aircraft Maintenance (IETM) Project at Lockheed Martin
(1)  Plan work breakdown structure and schedule of assigned task.
(2)  Perform software development of assigned task.
  - Produce software requirements
  - Produce software design
  - Produce source code
  - Produce SQL code
  - Produce database (DB) interface code
  - Unit Testing
  - Help with Integration and System Testing
  - Produce appropriate documentation
(3) Ensure that the correct software engineering process is being
     adhered to and improve as necessary.
(4) Review code and documentation for peers on the project.

positions.title: Software consultant
positions.description:
Worked on a software engineering consultant for J.P. Morgan for Global Assets Management project to manage various assets for J.P. Morgan.
- The Assets data was stored in SYBASE Database.
- The Client side of the software was Web based.

positions.title: Software Enginner
positions.description: -Worked on IETM Project at Lockheed Martin, This was a Client/Server based tool, used to author data for technical Manuals for F16/F22 Aircraft. The GUI is written with OI (Object Interface) Tool with C++/C and the backend Database used was SYBASE.
